data.one_liner: Provides network-aware widgets and checks internet connectivity status.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter apps to provide feedback on connectivity status by wrapping apps or specific widgets with network-aware components. It offers checkers to determine if a device is currently connected to the internet.
use_when: You want to display an offline banner or custom widget when the network connection drops.
You need to check internet connectivity asynchronously in your app logic.
avoid_when: You only need raw network status without UI components.
You rely solely on connectivity checks to reliably decide if you can make network requests without handling timeouts.
strengths: Easy setup with MaterialApp wrapping via ConnectivityAppWrapper.
Provides customizable offline widgets and banners.
Supports checking connectivity via a simple instance call.
weaknesses: Relies on older or specific dependencies like provider.
Does not replace proper timeout and network error handling.
data.setup_notes: Wrap your MaterialApp/CupertinoApp with ConnectivityAppWrapper and your body or widgets with ConnectivityWidgetWrapper.

alternatives.name: connectivity_plus
alternatives.why_pick_it: More actively maintained standard package for checking device connectivity status.
